bio.text: Roger Niello was elected to represent Placer and Sacramento counties in the California State Senate in 2022.

He began his career as a Certified Public Accountant, joined the family Niello Auto Group in 1974 and spent 25 years running automobile dealerships, then was elected to the Sacramento County Board of Supervisors in a 1999 special election and to the California State Assembly in 2004.
After the Assembly he was President and CEO of the Sacramento Metro Chamber of Commerce; he holds degrees from UC Berkeley and UCLA and lives in Fair Oaks.
